summary: Flag changes take minutes to show up
description: Support flipped a feature flag for a rider during a call and the change didn't seem to take effect right away -- the rider said the behaviour only changed a little while later.

comments.author: lev.anand
comments.body: Which flag was this, and roughly how long was the delay you saw?

comments.author: ren.okafor
comments.body: Checked with the team -- the cache on flags in each service holds for 5 minutes, so that lines up with the delay the rider saw.
